title: Centauri — AI Healthcare Platform
summary: Making AI-assisted healthcare operations understandable, checkable and fast for the people who sign off on every decision.
body:
## Overview

Centauri is an AI-powered enterprise platform for healthcare operations. Large volumes of records move through it every day, and many steps are now assisted by AI models. The design challenge was to speed teams up without hiding how a decision was reached.

## My role

I lead UX for the platform: discovery with operations teams, workflow mapping, interaction design, the component library, and coded prototypes that engineering builds from.

## The problem

- Users moved between several screens to verify a single record.
- AI suggestions appeared without enough context to trust or reject them quickly.
- Dense data tables were hard to scan and inconsistent between modules.

## Approach

**Human-in-the-loop by design.** Every AI suggestion shows its source fields and a confidence state, and the reviewer can accept, edit or override it in place. Overrides are logged so the team can see where the model needs work.

**Dashboards that answer one question first.** Each dashboard opens with what needs attention now, then lets people drill into queues, trends and individual records.

**A shared system.** I consolidated tables, filters, status chips and form patterns into one component library with accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA) built in, so new modules start consistent.

## Outcome

Review work moved into a single screen, AI output became explainable at the point of decision, and new features now ship from shared components instead of one-off designs.

> Add your real numbers here — time saved per record, error reduction, adoption — they make this case study much stronger.

title: Enterprise Operations Dashboard
summary: A command-level dashboard that turns live operational data into a picture leaders can read in seconds.
body:
## Overview

An enterprise dashboard for Dubai Police, designed with IDC Technologies, bringing operational data from several systems into one view for supervisors and leadership.

## My role

UX and UI lead: stakeholder workshops, information architecture, data-visualisation design and the UI kit.

## Approach

- Ran workshops to agree on the handful of indicators each role actually acts on.
- Built an information hierarchy of summary first, then trend, then detail.
- Designed chart and status patterns that stay legible on large wall displays and on laptops.
- Supported right-to-left Arabic layouts alongside English.

## Outcome

A consistent dashboard framework that could be extended to new units without redesigning from scratch.

title: Mamaearth, Aqualogica & The Derma Co
summary: Browse, discovery and checkout for three of India's fastest-growing D2C beauty brands, each with its own voice and one shared platform.
body:
## Overview

Honasa Consumer runs several direct-to-consumer brands on shared commerce infrastructure. I designed web and app experiences for Mamaearth, Aqualogica and The Derma Co.

## The challenge

Each brand needed a distinct personality, while the business needed one maintainable platform and fast campaign turnaround.

## Approach

- A shared component system with brand-level theming for colour, type and imagery.
- Clearer category navigation and filters, so shoppers could find products by concern and ingredient.
- Product pages restructured around benefits, ingredients and reviews.
- A shorter, mobile-first checkout.

## Outcome

Faster launches for new campaigns and collections, and a consistent shopping experience across three brands.

title: CashTrax
summary: A personal finance tracker that makes everyday spending visible without turning money into homework.
body:
## Overview

CashTrax helps people track income and spending and stay on top of their budget.

## Approach

- Quick entry for the most common transactions.
- A home screen that shows this month at a glance: spent, left, and what's coming up.
- Plain-language categories and gentle alerts instead of finance jargon.

## Outcome

A focused, low-effort tracking flow, designed and prototyped end to end.

title: Opal Travel — AI Redesign
summary: A self-initiated concept: what if a transit card app could plan, explain and fix your journey for you?
body:
## Overview

A concept redesign of the Opal travel apps that explores how AI could make public transport less stressful.

## Ideas explored

- A conversational trip planner that understands plain requests.
- Proactive disruption alerts with a suggested alternative, not just a warning.
- A clearer fare and top-up flow.

## Note

This is an independent concept and is not affiliated with Transport for NSW.

title: ShopClues & KindLife
summary: Marketplace and beauty-commerce journeys built for value-conscious shoppers on budget phones.
body:
## Overview

At Clues Network I worked on ShopClues, a large value marketplace, and KindLife, its beauty and wellness platform.

## Approach

- Lighter listing and search pages for low-end devices and slow networks.
- Clearer category navigation across a very large catalogue.
- Campaign and sale-event design at high volume.

## Outcome

Faster-loading, easier-to-scan shopping journeys and a repeatable campaign toolkit.
